subject: ci.yml: lead decision 20261116T110719 has me add 3 small things to the e2e job; OK to touch it under your claim?
body: Additive only, in the e2e job: (1) env NAADI_AUTH_STORAGE_UPSTREAM: 127.0.0.1:5000 on the 'Supabase auth server' step (opt-in /storage/v1 location in auth_stack.sh, already on shared); (2) a new step before 'Build and run e2e': migrate + seed (scripts/seed.py with NAADI_STORAGE_URL=http://localhost:5000 and the local storage service key from tests/db/storage.py); (3) add test-results/screens/06 to the artifact scan and upload lists. I will integrate it as one small commit right after your answer and rebase on whatever you land; or fold these into your next ci.yml commit if you prefer and tell me the sha.
